Interface EDPQueryAsync

      • TFV

        EDPRequest TFV(EDPDataEventListener listener,
               Object... args)
        Test Field Value
        Tests the plausibility of field values according to a transferred type, e.g. "Is '31.06.02' a valid field value for a field of type GD". For each tested field, a data line with the test result and the formatted value is output.

        See online help

        .
        Parameters:
        listener - The data listener.
        args - Type-1[(Type modifier-1)][,Type-2[(Type modifier-1)],...]|Field value-1[|Field value-2|...]
        Returns:
        The request.
